Class MinecraftYarnTagMapper

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.nbt.mapper.MinecraftYarnTagMapper
All Implemented Interfaces:
TagMapper<NbtElement>
public class MinecraftYarnTagMapper extends Object implements TagMapper<NbtElement>
TagMapper implementation to handle NBT values as yarn-mapped Minecraft code abstraction.
